exclusion_reason: No binary runtime option has been built or measured by BPTK.
promotion_trigger: Promote when each viable option runs the same approved PE32 fixture and the decision records correctness, performance, license, maintenance, and upstream relationship.
expected_failing_assertion: BPTK cannot execute the comparison PE32 fixture through a selected binary architecture.
active_gate_evidence: The source audit pins the candidate while the planning validator prevents an unsupported implementation claim.
procedure: Run the same fixture and browser profile through each license-compatible option.
Score artifact correctness, frame time, startup, memory, integration size, and maintenance risk.
pass_criterion: At least one option reaches the deterministic fixture result within every numeric BPTK-002 threshold at the frozen corpus version.
The decision rejects each alternative with measured evidence rather than preference.
